title: Shortest safe path from supervised flow to limited automation

ready_parts: supervised_batch_plan can produce READY/BLOCKED candidates in --no-write mode
strategy_engine already evaluates hedge/open/close decisions and key guards
queue/executor/direct-api path exists from supervised live flow
reconcile/fill_registry/lots path exists after exchange confirmation
reliably_working_parts: LIMIT-only direct API path under supervised confirmation
gross cap, profitable-lot, lot-spacing, active-queue/pending guards

minimal_automation_path: read_only loop: run planning for one allowlisted symbol on cadence and log readiness/guards only.
auto_enqueue only: when READY, enqueue one LIMIT candidate to action_queue without exchange submit.
auto_submit: for one symbol, one contract, LIMIT only, submit queued action after all guards pass and reconcile before next action.

exact_modules_needed.role: CLI entry for automated read-only runner.
Build candidates and expose READY/BLOCKED batch state.
Single-symbol proposal, guard, and safety evaluation.
Minimal enqueue target for READY candidates in auto_enqueue mode.
Existing queue execution path for later auto_submit mode.

hard_safety_rules: No submit while profitable-lot guard blocks.
Require gross cap pass before enqueue and submit.
Require no active queue or legacy pending conflict.
Reconcile after every submit before another submit.

no_code_conclusion.reason: It validates cadence, logging, state transitions, and guard stability before any queue writes or exchange risk.
